changed text and pixels, unchanged pair, added page and source fingerprint

multi-file literal search, original-case snippets and physical page links

non-contiguous unsorted duplicate selections retain relative order, content and geometry
back, intermediate and front block destinations report exact final indices

invalid object indices and physical pages publish no file
the common existing-output guard preserves the original destination

limits: Visual marks do not authenticate identity or provide cryptographic integrity. Adaptive cleanup can remove faint ink and is intended for thin dark marks on light paper; preview before placement.
Generated image/EXIF/placement tests do not qualify native pointer/tablet/Narrator interaction or real customer photos.
Windows packages remain unsigned without an independent publication key. ARM64 is cross-built only.
Interactive installed/portable updates/save, physical printing/GPU/ARM64 and named third-party readers remain separate qualification.
Broader hostile/customer corpus, coverage-guided fuzzing and PDF/A/PDF/UA conformance remain open under the 1.0 criteria.
delivery: PR #9 squash-merged after exact-head Windows and CodeQL checks. Immutable main/tag source and downloaded packages qualified. Post-publication commit contains documentation only; documentation-only main pushes skip rebuilding packages, while PR and code checks remain enabled.
